verdict.rationale: A documentation framework could plausibly ship a built-in AI assistant, so this axis applies to Docusaurus. The evidence pack covers MDX, plugins, Algolia search, versioning, i18n and the CLI, but nothing documents a built-in AI assistant that users can delegate tasks to. The probes also found no llms.txt or other AI-oriented endpoints.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
